profile.summary: The Fiscal Crisis and Management Assistance Team (FCMAT) is a California state-created team, established by Assembly Bill 1200 in 1991, that helps local TK-14 education agencies identify, prevent and resolve financial, operational and data management problems. It offers management assistance reviews, professional learning, fraud reviews and fiscal crisis intervention. The Kern County Superintendent of Schools serves as its administrative agent.
